verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents sharing files and folders with anyone, even people without an account, plus synced shared folders, viewer-only access, customizable sharing links, and password-protected files. Together these cover the organized-folders and view-only parts of a lightweight data room. Nothing in the evidence shows the download controls or access visibility (who viewed or downloaded) that diligence needs. Missing for 10: download disabling/controls on links, access/view analytics or activity visibility, link expiration, independent or hands-on corroboration of data-room use.
